user.title: Connect Amazon account
user.description: Sign in with your Amazon account. If two-step verification is enabled you can optionally enter the authenticator key (TOTP secret) – otherwise you will be asked for the code.

otp.title: Verification code
otp.description: Amazon requires a verification code (SMS or authenticator app).

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The login for {email} expired. Please enter your password again.

error.captcha: Amazon requires a captcha. Sign in once in a browser and try again later.
error.approval: Amazon wants you to approve the sign-in via app/e-mail. Approve it and try again.
